title: DelegatedAuthority
description: Authority envelope that MUST accompany every cross-agent or cross-tool action. Captures actor, delegate, operation scope, trust boundary, grant reference, and constraints. An OperationCommand is only valid when it references an unexpired, policy-conformant DelegatedAuthority envelope.

envelope_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for this delegation envelope.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry; expired envelopes fail closed regardless of grant state.

spiffe_id.description: SPIFFE identity of the principal that is delegating authority.

aum_digest.description: Attestation/workload measurement digest of the actor.

spiffe_id.description: SPIFFE identity of the agent or service receiving delegated authority.

operation.description: Specific operation type this envelope authorises.

scope.description: Capability references (capd:// URIs) in scope for this delegation.

trust_boundary_id.description: Reference to the TrustBoundary that governs this delegation.

grant_id.description: Reference to the Grant that authorises this delegation; must be valid and unexpired.

policy_hash.description: Hash of the policy evaluated when this envelope was issued.

constraints.description: Operational constraints inherited from or narrowed from the underlying Grant.

issuer.description: SPIFFE identity of the authority that signed this envelope.
